models.title: Models
models.description: Model ids or parts of them, for example 'anthropic/claude' or 'gpt-5'. Leave empty to collect the whole OpenRouter catalogue.

includeProviderBreakdown.title: Include per-provider prices
includeProviderBreakdown.description: For each model, also collect every provider serving it, with that provider's own price, uptime, latency and throughput. This is one extra request per model.

maxBreakdownModels.title: Max models for the breakdown
maxBreakdownModels.description: How many models to fetch provider details for, cheapest first. Keeps runs short when the catalogue is large.

includeOllama.title: Include Ollama library
includeOllama.description: Also list models from the Ollama library — these run on your own hardware, so their token price is zero.

maxPricePerMillionInputUsd.title: Max input price (USD per million tokens)
maxPricePerMillionInputUsd.description: Drop models above this input price. Leave empty for no limit.

maxItems.title: Max rows
maxItems.description: Stop after saving this many rows.
